name: gnothi
description: Gnothi — know yourself: a portrait of how you work with AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: A private portrait of how you work with AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Analyzes your local AI sessions and builds a private HTML report on how you collaborate with AI, where you spend time, and which work patterns recur.
defaultPrompt: Use $gnothi:portrait to analyze my local AI sessions and create a private HTML report on how I work.
